\code{consistent} & the numerical flux is consistent with the PDE flux & for all states u: F(u, ..., u) = f(u), as an identity & gloss only \\
\code{conservative} & the update is in flux form, so the total of u (of each component) is conserved on periodic grids & for every periodic grid of any size and every state in the domain: sum\_i (u\_i\^{}\{n+1\} - u\_i\^{}n) = 0 & \code{conserves\_\allowbreak{}of\_\allowbreak{}telescoping} \\
\code{positive\_\allowbreak{}under\_\allowbreak{}cfl} (nu\_range) & the linear update is a non-negative combination of its stencil values, so non-negative data stay non-negative & for all nu = a*dt/dx in the claimed range: every stencil weight is $\ge$ 0 & \code{NonnegComb.\allowbreak{}step\_\allowbreak{}nonneg} \\
\code{entropy\_\allowbreak{}stable\_\allowbreak{}tadmor} (eta, q) & entropy stable in Tadmor's semi-discrete sense for the given entropy pair & for all states uL, uR: Q = -[v](F - F*) $\ge$ 0, with v = eta'(u) & gloss only \\
\code{selects\_\allowbreak{}entropy\_\allowbreak{}solution\_\allowbreak{}semidiscrete} & the method-of-lines scheme's limit is the entropy solution & for all admissible data: the dx $\to$ 0 limit of the semi-discrete solution is the entropy solution & gloss only \\
\code{monotone\_\allowbreak{}under\_\allowbreak{}cfl} (c) & the update H is non-decreasing in each stencil value under the claimed CFL bound & for all states with lam*$|$f'(u)$|$ $\le$ c: H is non-decreasing in each argument & gloss only \\
\code{selects\_\allowbreak{}entropy\_\allowbreak{}solution} & the limit of the fully discrete scheme is the entropy solution, not another weak solution & for all admissible data: the dx $\to$ 0 limit at fixed dt/dx is the entropy solution & gloss only \\
\code{consistent\_\allowbreak{}order\_\allowbreak{}p} (p) & the discrete equations are consistent with the continuous ones to order at least p in the step (dx at fixed dt/dx for a linear scheme, h for a variational integrator) & for all smooth solutions: truncation error = O(dx\^{}p) (schemes), (1/h)$\cdot$DEL + EL = O(h\^{}p) (variational); at least p, so a higher order also verifies & gloss only \\
\code{exact\_\allowbreak{}order\_\allowbreak{}p} (p) & the DEL is consistent with the continuous EL equations to order exactly p & exactly p: at least p and not p + 1 (the h\^{}p coefficient of (1/h)$\cdot$DEL + EL is not identically 0) & gloss only \\
\code{von\_\allowbreak{}neumann\_\allowbreak{}stable\_\allowbreak{}under\_\allowbreak{}cfl} (nu\_range) & von Neumann (l2) stable on the claimed CFL range (linear constant-coefficient schemes) & for all nu = a*dt/dx in the claimed range and all theta: $|$g(theta)$|$ $\le$ 1 & gloss only \\
\code{stable\_\allowbreak{}for\_\allowbreak{}small\_\allowbreak{}cfl} & von Neumann stable for every small enough CFL number (linear constant-coefficient schemes) & there is nu0 $>$ 0 such that for all nu in (0, nu0] and all theta: $|$g(theta)$|$ $\le$ 1 & gloss only \\
\code{converges\_\allowbreak{}order\_\allowbreak{}p} (p) & the scheme converges to smooth solutions at order at least p, for each claimed refinement study & for each claimed study (combined, space, time): global error = O(step\^{}p) on smooth data & gloss only \\
\code{correct\_\allowbreak{}shock\_\allowbreak{}speed} & shocks move at the Rankine-Hugoniot speed in the limit dx $\to$ 0 at fixed dt/dx & for Riemann data whose entropy solution is a shock: the limit's shock moves at (f(uL) - f(uR))/(uL - uR) & gloss only \\
\code{limit\_\allowbreak{}is\_\allowbreak{}weak\_\allowbreak{}solution} & every bounded a.e. limit of the scheme as dx $\to$ 0 at fixed dt/dx is a weak solution (conditional on convergence) & for all data and every limit u (bounded, a.e., in L1\_loc): u is a weak solution & gloss only \\
\code{tvd\_\allowbreak{}under\_\allowbreak{}cfl} (nu\_range) & one step never increases the total variation, on the claimed CFL range & for every periodic state and every nu = a*dt/dx in the claimed range: TV(u\^{}\{n+1\}) $\le$ TV(u\^{}n) & gloss only \\
\code{local\_\allowbreak{}max\_\allowbreak{}principle\_\allowbreak{}under\_\allowbreak{}cfl} (nu\_range) & each new value lies between the smallest and largest values of its stencil, on the claimed CFL range & for every state, every nu = a*dt/dx in the claimed range and every i: min(stencil) $\le$ u\_i\^{}\{n+1\} $\le$ max(stencil) & gloss only \\
\code{truncation\_\allowbreak{}order\_\allowbreak{}smooth\_\allowbreak{}data} (p) & pointwise local truncation order at least p at every grid point of every smooth solution, extrema included & for all smooth u and every grid point: local truncation error = O(dx\^{}p) at fixed dt/dx & gloss only \\
\code{converges\_\allowbreak{}order\_\allowbreak{}p\_\allowbreak{}l1} (p) & the global error in the discrete L1 norm is O(dx\^{}p) at fixed dt/dx, on the spec's smooth test problem & on the spec's test problem: sum\_i $|$u\_i - u(x\_i)$|$ dx = O(dx\^{}p) as dx $\to$ 0 & gloss only \\
\code{converges\_\allowbreak{}order\_\allowbreak{}p\_\allowbreak{}linf} (p) & the global error in the max norm is O(dx\^{}p) at fixed dt/dx, on the spec's smooth test problem & on the spec's test problem: max\_i $|$u\_i - u(x\_i)$|$ = O(dx\^{}p) as dx $\to$ 0 & gloss only \\
\code{hyperbolic} & the system is strictly hyperbolic on the stated domain & for all q in the domain: df/dq has real, distinct eigenvalues & gloss only \\
\code{positive\_\allowbreak{}depth\_\allowbreak{}under\_\allowbreak{}cfl} (c) & the water depth h stays positive under the claimed CFL number (shallow water) & for all positive data and every step at which the CFL condition holds on every stencil: h\_i\^{}\{n+1\} $>$ 0 & gloss only \\
\code{converges\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}riemann\_\allowbreak{}solution} & the scheme converges in L1 to the exact (entropy) Riemann solution & on the spec's Riemann data: $|$$|$u\_dx - u\_exact$|$$|$\_L1 $\to$ 0 as dx $\to$ 0 at fixed dt/dx & gloss only \\
\code{del\_\allowbreak{}equations} & the claimed update is the discrete Euler--Lagrange equations of L\_d & for every triple (q\_k, q\_k+1, q\_k+2) in D: DEL(L\_d) = 0 iff the claimed update holds & \code{del\_\allowbreak{}verified\_\allowbreak{}meaning} \\
\code{discrete\_\allowbreak{}momentum\_\allowbreak{}conserved} & J(q0, q1) is constant, exactly, along every solution of the DEL equations that stays in D (a Noether momentum or any other such J) & for every N and every discrete trajectory q\_0..q\_N+1 in D solving the DEL: J(q\_N, q\_N+1) = J(q\_0, q\_1) & \code{dmomentum\_\allowbreak{}meaning} \\
\code{update\_\allowbreak{}conserves} & the explicit update map z' = Phi(z) conserves J exactly & for all z in D: J(Phi(z)) = J(z); so along every orbit in D, J(z\_N) = J(z\_0) & \code{update\_\allowbreak{}conserves\_\allowbreak{}meaning} \\
\code{update\_\allowbreak{}conserves\_\allowbreak{}order\_\allowbreak{}p} (p) & the explicit update map conserves J to order at least p: the per-step drift is O(h\^{}\{p+1\}) & J(Phi(z)) - J(z) = O(h\^{}\{p+1\}): the coefficients of h\^{}0 .. h\^{}p vanish identically & gloss only \\
\code{conserved} & Q is constant along every solution of the Euler--Lagrange equations of L that stays in D & for every trajectory twice differentiable on an open interval, with jet in D and solving the EL equations there: Q is constant on that interval & \code{conserved\_\allowbreak{}meaning} \\
\code{el\_\allowbreak{}equations} & the claimed equations of motion are the Euler--Lagrange equations of L on D & for every trajectory twice differentiable at t with jet in D: the EL equations of L hold at t iff the claimed equations hold at t & \code{verified\_\allowbreak{}meaning\_\allowbreak{}at} \\
\code{dim\_\allowbreak{}mismatch} (law) & a law of the theory is not dimensionally homogeneous & the two sides of the law have different dimensions under the theory's symbol dimensions & \code{Law.\allowbreak{}dimMismatch\_\allowbreak{}refutes} \\
\code{law\_\allowbreak{}vs\_\allowbreak{}evidence} (law, evidence) & a law of the theory fails everywhere in the box of a piece of evidence & for all values inside the evidence's hard bounds: the law does not hold & gloss only \\
\code{orbit\_\allowbreak{}excluded} (evidence) & the central force law admits no orbit with a perihelion and an aphelion in the observed boxes & for every angular momentum and every radial trajectory: no local min of r in the perihelion box together with a local max in the aphelion box & \code{EccentricExcluded.\allowbreak{}refutes} \\
\code{trajectory\_\allowbreak{}vs\_\allowbreak{}evidence} (evidence) & no trajectory of the theory's dynamics from the evidence's initial box is inside the observed box at the observation time & for all initial states and parameters in the evidence box: the state at t\_obs is outside the observed box (validated interval arithmetic, not Lean) & gloss only \\
